title: Good basic set for organization
text: Good basic set for organization. I liked that this came in several colors.  People who have multiple kids might like to have it that way so as to give everyone a set which can be identified as that person's set!  The colors are okay but the cream color shows dirt too fast and smudges are hard to remove.  Useful in the different sizes within a set.  Waterproof so art supplies and other not-too-dry items are okay to store here.
